title: No hardcoded text, no wrong keys
lead: Every text on this page comes from src/Content/Locales. Switch the language: everything changes instantly, including the document lang attribute.
compileTitle: A missing key does not compile
compileLead: Valid keys are derived from the pt-BR JSON. A typo becomes a compile error instead of broken text in production:
parityLead: If en-US does not have exactly the same keys as pt-BR, the build fails, and a test checks the same thing at runtime.
